items: ✅ BEST SELLING BIG BUTTON REMOTE - Flipper Remote is specifically designed for Seniors with large color-coded tactile buttons for easy use. Only 3 Functions; On/Off, Channel Up, Channel Down, Volume Up, Volume Down and Mute. It’s the perfect for gift for caregivers, elderly loved ones with Dementia or Alzheimer's or someone with low and impaired vision.

✅ ONE REMOTE for your TV ONLY or your TV + Cable Set Top Box (STB) media center. Also works a Soundbar. All IR infarred devices, including but not limited to Xfinity, Spectrum, Contour, DirecTV, Dish, ATT, Verizon, and TVs like Samsung, LG, Vizio, TCL, Panasonic, Insignia, etc;

✅ FAVORITES - CUSTOMIZE YOUR CONTENT - You can easily program up to 25 of your favorite channels so you can get to the content you desire. Making it easy to cycle through your channels and eliminates the hassle of searching through hundreds of useless channels you’d never watch.

items.label: ✅ DOES NOT WORK STREAMING set top boxes (STBs)
items.value: Flipper does not have navigation buttons to work DirecTV Air or boxes STBs by Roku / Apple / Google TV / Fios TV+; HDMI Dongles by Roku / Fire TV; or Streaming apps like Netflix, Youtube, Prime, etc

items.label: ✅Xfinity
items.value: Flipper works Xfinity and requires direct line of sight to the Xfinity box. Some Xfinity boxes are located behind the TV or furniture. If so, then purchase any number of IR Extenders on Amazon.

items: ✅ Our SPECIAL SOFTWARE - knows where to send the right signal, prevents accidental reprogramming. No Input button, and our new silicon cover hide the unnecessary buttons.
